summary: Diff adds an admin create-and-publish flow: a new backend method stub `adminCreateAndPublishArticle`, new React Query mutation `useCreateAndPublishArticle`, Admin moderation page state/handler for creating an article, and an updated Articles empty-state message mentioning publication. However, backend implementation details are truncated, so key REQ-1 acceptance criteria (publishing visibility, validation, and full admin restriction behavior) cannot be confirmed from the provided diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend method must prevent bad states (error/trap on empty title or duplicate existing published title).
missing_requirements.reason: Validation logic is not visible because the new function body is truncated right after the authorization check begins.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend admin-only method must be restricted to admin callers (same checks as existing admin endpoints).
missing_requirements.reason: The method begins an admin permission check, but due to truncation (it cuts off at `Run...`), it cannot be confirmed that the final implementation correctly enforces admin-only access and returns/handles unauthorized calls consistently.
